item.title: Craft a Winning Resume Start 🌟 • Use: “I excel in X by leveraging Y skills.” • Tailor your summary to each job description. • Highlight key achievements with numbers. • Focus on skills that match the role. • Keep it concise—3 to 4 impactful sentences. How can you make your summary irresistible to hiring managers? #resume #jobsearch #ScalePilot #SocialPilot #AIAutomations
